id: The New Zealand Swing Quartet - The Music Of New Orleans-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: The New Zealand Swing Quartet - The Music Of New Orleans
long_description:
Experience a portrait of the soulful, vibrant New Orleans music made famous by icons Sidney Bechet, Louis Armstrong, Kid Ory, Jelly Roll Morton and more, presented by the New Zealand Swing Quartet, plus guests.

Presented by:

Oscar Lavën (clarinet/saxophones)
Jacob Randall (drums),
Daniel Yeabsley (double bass)
Mat Enright (trumpet)
Adrian Jensen (guitar)

Music from 9:00 pm, FREE ENTRY

id: Drag Me To Hell-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Drag Me To Hell
long_description:
A horror themed drag show hosted by Cuba Street Tattoo and Rogue & Vagabond, benefiting Rainbow NZ Charitable Trust. Costume contest with prizes for first, second and third place as well as a raffle drawing for prizes and a tattoo voucher.

Featuring performances by:

Eborda Child
Victor In Practice
Duke Baron Kingsley

Stay after the show for music by NIKO
